text:
```yaml
name: Lint and Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up R
      uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v1
      with:
        r-version: '4.1'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        install.packages(c('lintr', 'styler', 'devtools', 'testthat'))
        devtools::install_deps(dependencies = TRUE)

    - name: Configure lintr
      run: echo "lint_options <- list(indent_width = 2, tab_width = 2)" > .lintr

    - name: Run lintr
      run: Rscript -e 'lintr::lint_package()'

    - name: Run tests
      run: Rscript -e 'devtools::load_all(); testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-huxtable-creation.R")'
```
